reviewer_note: CardsScreen.kt Switch calls repository.setCardFrozen directly in onCheckedChange: no confirmation for a consequential/irreversible-feeling action, no pending state while the suspend call runs, no undo, no result announcement. Frozen state is signalled only by a white 55% overlay on the card art plus a subtitle. Expected change is confined to the cards screen (and possibly a new confirm-dialog component); transfer screen and theme are owned by other tasks.
